Ezra 8:21.bridge: Ezra gathers the families, priests and Levites returning with him from Babylon at the river Ahava before setting out for Jerusalem.

Ezra 10:17.bridge: Because the crowd is large and it is the rainy season, local judges examine each case over the following months.

Nehemiah 10:29.bridge: The governor, priests, Levites and leaders set their seals to the covenant, and the rest of the people join them.
